Extends the PROVEN single-cube CP-CONV-02-SRC (1/1+1/1 chain) to N=3 by iterating source_paths=[Cube_1,Cube_2,Cube_3] with per-cube drop_targets onto the tray.
thoughts: Mechanism (verified against handlers/pick_place.py _gen_pick_place_curobo): the cuRobo controller iterates SOURCE_PATHS, selecting the undelivered cube nearest the PickSensor (candidate-by-distance-to-sensor); it belt-freezes while a cube is imminent/being picked (the single-robot standing freeze fires because _belt_is_moving, v=0.2>0.05 — line 5770) so the next cube does NOT ride off the end during the ~15s pick; on resume it WAKES sleeping upstream belt cubes (line 5816, the general multi-item belt-pick fix 'item rides +0.71 vs 0.0') so they advance to the EndStop for the next cycle. This is the SAME multi-cube belt engine that delivers CP-08's 4 belt cubes (3/4-4/4); the only novelty vs CP-08 is the REAL ConveyorBelt_A09 asset + EndStop wall, which CP-CONV-02-SRC already proved works for 1 cube. drop_targets (dict, _bin_drop_pos line 4921) routes each cube to a distinct tray slot so the handoff is a 3-cube flat-grid a multi-cube receiver picks. REACH (Franka base [0.5,0,0.75], identity orient -> picks across the table): pick at EndStop x~0 = 0.50m from base (<0.85); tray slots [0.40/0.50/0.60,-0.5] = 0.50-0.51m (<0.85) -> all reachable.
code:
# CP-CONV-02-SRC-3: MULTI-CUBE (N=3) variant of the PROVEN CP-CONV-02-SRC real-conveyor chain source.
# Identical real ConveyorBelt_A09 + lowered Conveyor@[0,0,-1.0] + EndStop + downstream Franka + open
# HandoffTray, but stages THREE cubes on the belt (distinct x, 0.30m apart) and delivers each to a DISTINCT
# tray slot via per-cube drop_targets (CP-08 multi-cube pattern). The cuRobo controller iterates source_paths
# and feeds the belt cube-by-cube (standing belt-freeze + upstream-wake on resume).
create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", attr_name="inputs:intensity", value=1000.0)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": False, "broadphase_type": "MBP"})

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Conveyor", prim_type="Xform", position=[0.0, 0.0, -1.0])
add_reference(prim_path="/World/Conveyor", reference_path="/mnt/shared_data/isaac-sim-assets-complete-5.0.0/Assets/Isaac/5.0/Isaac/Props/Conveyors/ConveyorBelt_A09.usd")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", schema_name="PhysicsRigidBodyAPI")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physics:kinematicEnabled", value=True)
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", schema_name="PhysxSurfaceVelocityAPI")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physxSurfaceVelocity:surfaceVelocity", value=[0.2, 0.0, 0.0])
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physxSurfaceVelocity:surfaceVelocityEnabled", value=True)
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physxSurfaceVelocity:surfaceVelocityLocalSpace", value=True)

# EndStop wall: cubes ride +X and accumulate against it at the pick zone (x~0.03). Wide in y (0.45) so
# all three cubes halt on the belt centerline. (identical to CP-CONV-02-SRC)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/EndStop", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.03, 0.0, 0.82], scale=[0.01, 0.45, 0.05])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/EndStop", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.5, 0.0, 0.375], scale=[0.15, 0.15, 0.375])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

robot_wizard(robot_name="Franka", dest_path="/World/Franka", position=[0.5, 0.0, 0.75], orientation=[0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0])

# THREE belt-staged cubes (distinct x, 0.30m apart, all on belt-top z=0.781 -> bottom rests). Cube_1 already
# at the EndStop pick zone; Cube_2/Cube_3 queue upstream and ride in after each pick (belt-resume + wake).
for i, x in enumerate([-0.02, -0.32, -0.62]):
    path = f"/World/Cube_{i+1}"
    create_prim(prim_path=path, prim_type="Cube", position=[x, 0.0, 0.806], size=0.05)
    for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
        apply_api_schema(prim_path=path, schema_name=api)
    apply_api_schema(prim_path=path, schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
bulk_set_attribute(prim_paths=[f"/World/Cube_{i+1}" for i in range(3)], attr="physxRigidBody:sleepThreshold", value=0.0)
for i in range(3):
    apply_physics_material(prim_path=f"/World/Cube_{i+1}", material_name="rubber")

# CHAIN-SOURCE delivery: an OPEN flat tray (top ~0.78) on a support pedestal. Widened to 0.44x0.44 (half
# 0.22) vs SRC's 0.34 so all THREE 3-in-a-row slots (x 0.40/0.50/0.60) land on the tray with margin.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/TraySupport", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.5, -0.5, 0.375], scale=[0.25, 0.25, 0.375])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/TraySupport", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
create_prim(prim_path="/World/HandoffTray", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.5, -0.5, 0.76], scale=[0.44, 0.44, 0.04])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/HandoffTray", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

add_proximity_sensor(sensor_path="/World/PickSensor", position=[0.0, 0.0, 0.85], size=[0.08, 0.08, 0.14])

# Per-cube drop_targets: 3-in-a-row on the tray top (z=0.825 = tray-top 0.80 + cube half 0.025), 0.10m apart
# so the 3-cube handoff is a flat-grid a multi-cube receiver picks (CP-08 drop_targets pattern + CP-CONV-02-SRC
# belt/sensor/curobo source).
setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/Franka",
    target_source="curobo",
    sensor_path="/World/PickSensor",
    belt_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt",
    source_paths=["/World/Cube_1", "/World/Cube_2", "/World/Cube_3"],
    destination_path="/World/HandoffTray",
    drop_targets={
        "/World/Cube_1": [0.40, -0.5, 0.825],
        "/World/Cube_2": [0.50, -0.5, 0.825],
        "/World/Cube_3": [0.60, -0.5, 0.825],
    },
    planning_obstacles=["/World/EndStop", "/World/HandoffTray"],
)
